recommendation: Auto-only, default-disabled, explicit-owner/operator-invoked finite pickup is a coherent bounded next dependency. Four focused gates are proportionate; no old broad sweep is required.

requiredPlanClarificationsBeforeImplemen.finding: A raw preparing hint can reconcile in accepted H to submitted when its lease expired and everDispatched is false; I2 may then prepare. Replace the blanket no-dispatch statement with canonical post-reconciliation authority. Ever-dispatched ambiguous continuation remains needs-user-action/no retry.

Explicitly classify busy, lease-lost, aborted, provider-required and step-limit outcomes as unhandled unless final canonical state proves completion; retain that position rather than advancing merely because work returned. Distinguish end-of-cycle from interrupted continuation.

reserveAuto is transactional, but settleAuto separately updates the event and lifetime counter. Before promising crash/once settlement, pin a narrow atomic transaction and per-reservation settlement strategy using existing rows, conservative estimate including wire/history/output bounds, per-exchange request/token/cache units and actual-usage-over-estimate behavior. Unknown/malformed/aborted usage retains reservation. Stop if this needs a broader ledger/policy change.

scopeAssessment: No additional queue, UI/HTTP, daemon, provider fallback, production activation or real model run is authorized. Exact owner/account eligibility and account admission must precede dispatch; approved execution must not require provider/secret lookup.

execution.note: Source/document plan inspection only; no runtime/test/state/Git changes.
